entities.name: Johann Daniel Mylius
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johann Daniel Mylius was a composer for the lute, and writer on alchemy. Born at Wetter in present-day Hesse, Germany, he went on to study theology and medicine at the University of Marburg. He was the brother-in-law and pupil of Johann Hartmann (1568–1613).
